Lessons: (1) a Worker request is a bounded room (128 MB, one invocation's CPU): a whole-file import belongs in rounds the page drives, each request re-streaming the file and keeping only its window, the log row written first with counts that grow; (2) design the round protocol so the server never trusts the client's arithmetic (it recounts the file every round and checks the row count against the mount row); (3) look up existing rows by the natural key alone, never by a scope column, or a record that legitimately moves scope (a package between our licenses) collides on insert; (4) the smoke's process idles after SMOKE PASS until the timeout (exit 124 is the norm); the gate is the pass line plus the migration count, then the orphan sweep; (5) a test template literal that reads a Response body in its message consumes the body even when the assertion passes; read the body only on failure.
